No export scaling.", "simplification": "Meaning-specific reconstruction with original 1.4 mm strokes and freshly sampled 1.2 mm Index dots. The selected cyclic fructose graph preserves all twelve atom glyphs, twelve bonds, six carbon-centre markers and six empty oxygen glyphs. Original connectivity and above/below substituent relationships are retained, including the five-membered ring and two external carbon groups. Node positions and glyph sizes are independently re-laid out. Continuous profiles retain solid 6.4 mm carbon centres; Index uses a five-dot compact cross cluster for each carbon centre, preserving the marked-versus-empty distinction. Hydrogen is implicit from the original neutral-valence key; circles are node glyphs, not additional chemical rings. The external selected-isomer/Haworth key remains essential.", "canvas_mm": [170, 200]}, "teaching": "The selected cyclic fructose graph preserves all twelve atom glyphs, twelve bonds, six carbon-centre markers and six empty oxygen glyphs. Original connectivity and above/below substituent relationships are retained, including the five-membered ring and two external carbon groups. Node positions and glyph sizes are independently re-laid out. Continuous profiles retain solid 6.4 mm carbon centres; Index uses a five-dot compact cross cluster for each carbon centre, preserving the marked-versus-empty distinction. Hydrogen is implicit from the original neutral-valence key; circles are node glyphs, not additional chemical rings. The external selected-isomer/Haworth key remains essential. External object-name and viewpoint key required; physical tactile and learner evaluation remain pending.
